## Sheet P — Ô mây mặc định: 3 hướng

- Lưu thành: `art_inbox/.batch/cloud-11-plot/P.png`
- Đính kèm (theo thứ tự): `1_style_building.png`, `P_2_hint.png`, `P_3_hint.png`
- Kết quả: lưới 1×3: plot_cloud, plot_cloud_b, plot_cloud_c

```text
Image 1 is the STYLE REFERENCE: finished art from my game. Copy its art style exactly: a dark warm-brown outline (never black) of even weight, soft cel shading with one shadow tone and one highlight tone, light from the top-left, warm pastel colours of medium saturation, a subtle painted texture, rounded chunky friendly shapes, low-to-medium detail. Do NOT copy the objects of image 1.
Image 2 is a crop of my game's own art showing a coloured skin version of this same cloud bed in my game: use it for shape, material and colour, in the same style as image 1.
Image 3 is a crop of my game's own art showing another coloured skin version of this same cloud bed in my game: use it for shape, material and colour, in the same style as image 1.

Draw ONE image: a sheet of 3 separate game sprites in a clean grid of 1 row(s) x 3 column(s), in exactly this order, left to right, top to bottom:
Row 1: (1) Cloud bed with a soil nest: a plump puffy cushion of soft white cloud, gently domed, with a small neat oval of dark rich soil nestled in a shallow dip on its top, the cloud puffs curling softly over the soil's rim; (2) Cloud bed with a soft dip: a plump puffy cushion of soft white cloud with a ring of round puffs around a slightly sunken centre of smoother pale-blue cloud, no soil; (3) Cloud bed with a tiny soil patch: a wide plump cushion of white cloud with cream highlights, a few tiny curls on its sides, and a small round patch of dark soil peeking out of the middle of its top.
All three are the PLAIN default version of the cloud bed in images 2 and 3: the same size, the same plump rounded cushion shape and outline weight, seen from the same angle, filling the cell the same way, but in natural cloud colours (soft white with pale sky-blue and faint lilac shading on the shadow side, warm cream highlights). Clean, soft and inviting, a little prettier than images 2 and 3, never busy. No flowers, no plants, no crystals, no stars, no faces. Each one is a single bed seen once: do not draw a second copy of any bed. Original design, no resemblance to any other game, film or brand.
Three-quarter view from slightly above. The bed is the whole object: no grass patch, no cloud platform and nothing else under or around it, only a very soft contact shadow.

Every object is fully visible and centred in its own cell, with wide empty gaps between objects; nothing touches, overlaps or crosses into another cell. Wide landscape image.
Background: one plain flat light-grey colour (#C8C8C8) everywhere. No gradient, no texture, no floor, no cast shadow on the background.
No text, letters, numbers, labels, captions, watermark, logo, border or frame. Not glossy, not a 3D render, not flat vector, not pixel art. No glow, no sparkles, no floating particles.
```
